findings.title: Account identity
findings.evidence_contract: An expired directory row, uploader attribution, and recovered account docket independently share `mkept` and Copperline identifiers. Players deduce that mkept and the host are real, while the damaged service field remains unsolved. Provenance: public Copperline pages with stable route and capture receipt.

findings.title: Service 1842
findings.evidence_contract: Damage notation on the directory, a separate staff convention in ticket history, and the docket marks establish the transformation used to recover `1842`. The teaching key is not adjacent to the encoded field. Players file the service number, not an occult phrase.

findings.title: Intentional preservation
findings.evidence_contract: Ticket `9137`, an archive post, and backup timestamps form a custody sequence: mkept reopened access, checked the artifact, and left a route another person could follow. This rules out an accidental public leak and opens P2.

findings.title: Artifact custody
findings.evidence_contract: Copperline’s post, README, byte/hash receipt, and in-world backup label identify one immutable `hold.zip`. Players prove they opened the promised artifact rather than a mirror or replacement.

findings.title: Host reconstruction
findings.evidence_contract: Numbered service shelves, a desk index, and mundane ownership books yield the hostname. The address operation is physically grounded and wrapping-independent.

findings.title: Port and endpoint
findings.evidence_contract: Dispatch paperwork supplies the port; a routing diagram shows host and port are separate fields. Combining P2.F2 and P2.F3 yields the sole live endpoint.

findings.title: One-runtime handoff
findings.evidence_contract: The accepted dispatch receipt states that post-onboarding records continue on the live service. It contains no Discord invitation and no post-prologue progression.

findings.title: Lived settlement
findings.evidence_contract: Work schedules, traded goods, repairs, and three residents’ overlapping practical directions establish an ongoing community. No one delivers the campaign premise.

findings.title: Selective disturbance
findings.evidence_contract: A changed mark is visible to one positioned player while a public maintenance record shows the unchanged baseline. The deduction is that observation is uneven, not that a named supernatural entity has been explained.

findings.title: Dispatch authority
findings.evidence_contract: The P2 receipt, a covered survey, and an Orientation Key identify the legitimate dispatch filing. Filing returns the key and reveals the Discord route privately; the old slot-13/handle ritual is not retained.

findings.title: Proof-bound identity
findings.evidence_contract: Short-lived in-game proof plus ticket `9137` binds each Discord account idempotently. A group receipt opens the shared docket without making attendance eligibility.

findings.title: Public Mouth
findings.evidence_contract: Drainage maps, cart wear, and resident memory converge on one public Mouth, distinct from the village well and with the same return route.

findings.title: Three build phases
findings.evidence_contract: Material joins, survey revisions, and room-use records establish shelter → civic → deep phases without an item-frame ordering station.

findings.title: Refuge capacity
findings.evidence_contract: Population, ration, heat, and intake records cross-check approximate capacity. The deduction is operational viability, not a printed arithmetic exercise.

findings.title: Rational descent
findings.evidence_contract: Founding minutes eliminate exposed lateral travel and shallow fuel dependence; stable heat, water, and cover explain why they dug down.

findings.title: Intake finding
findings.evidence_contract: Players file the phase/capacity/motive synthesis and receive an intake receipt opening P5, not a configurable orientation model.

findings.title: Ordinary life matrix
findings.evidence_contract: School copybooks, market tallies, dwelling repairs, trade tools, and family ration exceptions prove education, commerce, maintenance, and care.

findings.title: Kept Light / Offering / Sacred Beast
findings.evidence_contract: Lamp service, communal sample-return, and bird/air records prove useful heat-air, reserve, and warning procedures; later penalty ledgers show favoritism, tribute, and superstition masking maintenance.

findings.title: Deep Line / Bow
findings.evidence_contract: Survey limits and low-seal inspection records prove safe boring/load limits and a practical crouched view; later rulings use them to suppress travel and stage submission.

findings.title: Dark Hours / Unspoken
findings.evidence_contract: Paired watch and bounded vibration listening protect exhausted workers; later rotas and discipline convert them into surveillance, sleep punishment, and censorship.

findings.title: Institutional drift
findings.evidence_contract: Date/provenance comparison across all seven shows repeated memory aids acquiring moral language and enforcement power after their practical adoption.

findings.title: Vaun / inventory audit
findings.evidence_contract: Receiving ledgers, cistern receipts, private-heat staples, and his private reconciliation prove an unexplained supply diversion he tracked but did not challenge.

findings.title: Mara / version control
findings.evidence_contract: Paper stock, signatures, route editions, margins, and a bounded route check identify the substituted manual and her ordered revision. No client-wrapped line count.

findings.title: Sella / shoreline survey
findings.evidence_contract: Static transferred drawings, fixed landmarks, sample sketches, and measured bearing establish the true intake and omitted lower sample. KS01’s spawned-frame set is replaced at design level by static evidence with an earned reflection reason.

findings.title: Orin / structural tolerance
findings.evidence_contract: Crouched masonry marks, measured fracture layers, brace dimensions, and his conditional certificate prove warnings were signed away. Reused dial inputs are absent.

findings.title: Brann / watch correction
findings.evidence_contract: Rota substitutions, meal chit, visual lamp/toll redundancy, and preserved clip 3 (`STAY AWAKE`) prove paired watch and the altered timestamp. The payload does not mean supernatural sleeplessness.

findings.title: Iss / persuasive route case
findings.evidence_contract: Living reed provenance, route records, resource decisions, and corrected margins establish that he found a healed surface, made dangerous omissions, and helped sign Averyn out. The full Break and Averyn/Record relationship remain unrevealed.

findings.title: Six-person matrix
findings.evidence_contract: Independent handwriting, workspaces, dates, cross-references, and mutually incompatible duties prove six contemporaries. Their sealed affidavits remain independently proven artifacts; their hidden letters are not exposed until P11.

findings.title: Complaint chronology
findings.evidence_contract: Nessa’s signed labels and complaints place sediment/pressure before cloth shedding and her removal.

findings.title: Material/flow proof
findings.evidence_contract: A-lower samples, fixed pipe/valve diagrams, authentic cloth weave, and Vaun’s diversion record prove material failure and displaced genuine supply. The valve model is static reasoning, not a frame-combination station.

findings.title: Labor proof
findings.evidence_contract: Removal date, meal chit, stair mark, and Brann’s corrected watch show Toma relieved Nessa and the clean rota was edited.

findings.title: Procurement proof
findings.evidence_contract: Supplier invoice, purchase receipt, market provenance, and weave comparison identify counterfeit cloth without an adjacent Polybius table.

findings.title: Preserved cache
findings.evidence_contract: Clip 2’s earned payload `WHERE THE REEDS FOLD BACK` plus Sella’s survey locates Averyn’s cache: original filter, purchase receipt, and Drafts A/B. Visual captions and a shoreline still redundantly carry the payload.

findings.title: Nessa exoneration
findings.evidence_contract: The accepted conclusion must say Nessa followed procedure and name the diverted/counterfeit supply plus hidden evidence. Averyn’s authorship and suppression are recorded; Nessa is not reduced to foreshadowing.

findings.title: Failure chronology
findings.evidence_contract: Lamp residue, bird care tags, and overwritten watch strokes prove outage and warning failure preceded the official alarm.

findings.title: Preexisting structure/load
findings.evidence_contract: Mineralized fracture, pressure-map alignment, undersized brace, and inner-seal reachability prove chronic damage and redirected load existed before Iss’s cut.

findings.title: True surface / unsafe remedy
findings.evidence_contract: Living reed, viable water/air dates, authorization gaps, and hidden route geometry prove the surface healed and Iss’s excavation was dangerous.

findings.title: Record feedback
findings.evidence_contract: The altered region contains copied structures that preserve official edits more cleanly than originals; baseline surveys and impossible copy timestamps prove the Record changed living structures during failure without defining the Dark.

findings.title: Multi-cause finding
findings.evidence_contract: A valid causal graph must contain preexisting material failure, allocation/maintenance, record falsification/delay, Iss’s accelerator, and Record/Dark feedback. No single-person or supernatural-only theory passes.

findings.title: Water repair
findings.evidence_contract: Recover and install the proven filter component; local readback changes water state and remains valid through network outage.

findings.title: Light/pressure/route repair
findings.evidence_contract: Earned service documentation decodes the fixed lamp circuit, pressure readings identify the bypass, and a painted service route reaches the physical correction. The repeated Orin/HS item-frame dial answer is retired.

findings.title: Systems integration
findings.evidence_contract: Water, light, pressure, survey, and route receipts synchronize once, visibly alter the live world, and issue the durable access proof for P9.

findings.title: Camp location
findings.evidence_contract: Supply route, torn map corner, and Wren’s inconsistent distance locate the camp; the two independent sources agree before his account is used as contradiction.

findings.title: Four lives
findings.evidence_contract: Admin tools, camera kit, builder corrections, and companion effects establish mkept/Ash/Rook/Wren as four distinct occupants with work and relationships.

findings.title: Archive keying
findings.evidence_contract: Supply provenance yields the `ROOK` column key; notebook and map overlay combine into an earned Copperline route. Container ordering and overlay are evidence steps, not standalone stations.

findings.title: Near-release plan
findings.evidence_contract: Route notes, completed components, and a readiness checklist show all required answer classes were known; the remaining gap is unexplained interference.

findings.title: Ash media
findings.evidence_contract: The earned page reveals preserved clip 1 and stills. Camera-station provenance plus grouped latch marks yield `ASH-13`; visual/caption redundancy preserves fairness.

findings.title: Locker 13
findings.evidence_contract: The protected locker yields the Witness Spool and Rook’s changed route. Their timestamps create the open question carried into P10: who exposed a private revision?

findings.title: Opportunity matrix
findings.evidence_contract: Private quotations, camera/offline receipts, and route knowledge show only Wren had access to every leaked detail. This absorbs the old A10 synthesis.

findings.title: Deliberate transmission
findings.evidence_contract: Spool packets correlate Wren’s channel with names, plans, routes, schedules, and fears; timestamps rule out passive Record inference.

findings.title: Confrontation
findings.evidence_contract: Evidence-gated dialogue makes Wren admit the channel and fear while denying neither agency nor uncertainty about survival.

findings.title: Independent Bridge proof
findings.evidence_contract: Rook’s counter-mark, not Wren’s word, opens the route and yields the Protocol Bridge, preserving independent verification.

findings.title: Reckoning
findings.evidence_contract: Condemn, understand, or free is a player judgment after facts are fixed. Every branch yields a finishable Bridge state and only changes remembrance.

findings.title: Human voice
findings.evidence_contract: The recovered five-file packet and WAV custody receipt are reviewed together. A spectrogram plus accessible visual companion yields `I WAS NOT KEPT`, the first unambiguous constrained-human evidence.

findings.title: Vaun A provenance
findings.evidence_contract: Vaun A, Mara V, Sella E, Orin R, Brann Y, and Iss corrected N each arise from that person’s independently proven affidavit and earlier professional method. Iss’s false M is explicitly rejected. These are six provenance receipts, not six repeated submission stations and not an act that frees Averyn.

findings.title: AVERYN identity
findings.evidence_contract: Ordered by six distinct dossier identities, the letters spell AVERYN. P7 records establish registrar/cistern analyst; roster deletion proves erasure rather than a vacant themed seat.

findings.title: Relationship model
findings.evidence_contract: Human archive design + Dark-adjacent copying + constrained language + Averyn’s recoverable paths support: Record is a civic system built near the Dark; Averyn is trapped interface; Watcher is its defensive voice through her constraint. No pair is identical.

findings.title: Release instruction
findings.evidence_contract: Earned preserved clip 4 yields `SIX RETURN, ONE IS NOT KEPT` with visual transcript. It means return six affidavits and leave Averyn’s Record slot unbound.

findings.title: Readiness/convergence
findings.evidence_contract: A machine-readable local audit proves every required finding, repair, and artifact receipt. Missing work names its arc; attendance cannot substitute for evidence.

findings.title: Chamber configuration
findings.evidence_contract: Six affidavits enter named testimony housings; Averyn remains empty; Cistern Seal, System Key, and Protocol Bridge enter unique validated housings. Wrong items return whole.

findings.title: Remembrance choices
findings.evidence_contract: Players choose publish or deliberate unfiling and carry the already committed Wren judgment. Plain language states both name paths free Averyn.

findings.title: Protected release
findings.evidence_contract: Player confirmation plus operator arm writes choices and local finale phase durably before theater. It closes the Record; no branch matrix changes that outcome.

findings.title: Shutdown and coda
findings.evidence_contract: Light-death wave, Averyn’s direct voice, save, goodbye, kick, production shutdown, and persistent coda occur idempotently. External mirrors may lag but cannot interrupt local closure.
